subject.title: [Bug]: Trajectory files fed back as context cause unbounded token consumption and unexpected API billing

question: Should this issue stay open until the exact current-main Windows fresh-session provider-billing path is live-proven, or is the current source/test hardening enough to close as fixed?
rationale: The code now excludes trajectory artifacts and bounds history/reseed paths, but the costly reporter evidence was gathered on older releases and has not been replayed against current main.

options.title: Require current-main live proof
options.body: Keep this issue open until a focused Windows or equivalent fresh-session run proves large trajectory sidecars do not enter provider input tokens.

options.title: Close from source hardening
options.body: Close as fixed only if maintainers accept source and unit coverage as sufficient despite the missing provider-billing replay.

options.title: Add a stronger guardrail first
options.body: Ask for a narrow PR that asserts trajectory sidecars cannot be selected by any model-context, memory, or reseed path before closing.

recommendation.title: Require current-main live proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until a focused Windows or equivalent fresh-session run proves large trajectory sidecars do not enter provider input tokens.

likelyOwner.reason: The current classifier and reseed guardrail blame points to steipete's recent context/session work, making him the best available decision owner for proof sufficiency.
